svg.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion, worked example
svg.desc: A vector ranking (m3, m1, m7) with weight 1.0 and a BM25 ranking (m1, m9, m3) with weight 0.8 are fused with k = 60. The fused order is m1 0.0292, m3 0.0291, m7 0.0159, m9 0.0129. The entity-graph channel is optional and off by default. Illustrative ranks; the weights and k are the defaults in the code.

svg.text: A memory ranked well by both channels beats one ranked first by only one of them,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and cosine and bm25 are never compared on the same scale.
